title: Cocycle lifting for injective module presheaves without a covering condition
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a category, let $R$ be a presheaf of rings, and let $M$ be an injective object [def-sp-injective-resolutions] in its category of module presheaves [def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification]. Let $f_t:U_t\to U$ be a family indexed by a set $T$, with chosen iterated fibre products and index maps $S$ as in [def-weil-pbc-site-cech-complex]. For every $q\geq0$ and cochain $c\in\check C^{q+1}(S,M)$ whose alternating restriction differential is zero, there is a cochain $b\in\check C^q(S,M)$ whose alternating restriction differential is $c$. No topology, covering condition, or sheaf condition is assumed. Hom-sets of $\mathcal C$, the values of $R$ and $M$, and $T$ lie in one universe $v$, so all free module presheaves used in the argument belong to the category in which $M$ is injective.

proof.text: Construct tuplePresheaf(X) as the disjoint union of Hom(X,W(n,t)) over index tuples. The specified indexMap gives a simplicial object: product uniqueness verifies the functor laws. Apply the free module functor and alternatingFaceMapComplex to construct K=S.freeComplex R. All its values lie in universe v.
Apply [lem-weil-pbc-site-cech-free-complex-exact] to get exactness at q+1. Convert ExactAt into exactness of K(q+2)→K(q+1)→K(q).

Construct freeCochainEquiv by evaluating morphisms on the basis (t,id). Its inverse extends the natural map (t,g)↦M(g)(b(t)) by the free module adjunction. Naturality proves both inverse laws and additivity. Each face corresponds to restriction by indexMap; distributing the sum and integer multiples gives boundary compatibility, as in [lem-weil-pbc-free-yoneda-presheaf-module].

The inverse equivalence sends c to a:K(q+1)→M. Boundary compatibility shows the incoming boundary followed by a is zero. Apply Mathlib ShortComplex.Exact.descToInjective using [def-sp-injective-resolutions]. comp_descToInjective and the comparison prove d(b)=c.

theorem injective_presheaf_module_cech_cocycle_lift
    {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] (R : Cᵒᵖ ⥤ RingCat.{v})
    (M : PresheafOfModules.{v} R) [Injective M]
    {T : Type v} {U : C} (f : T → C) (hom : ∀ t, f t ⟶ U)
    (S : SiteCechComplex f hom) (q : ℕ)
    (c : S.cochains M.presheaf (q + 1))
    (hc : S.differentialValue M.presheaf (q + 1) c = 0) :
    ∃ b : S.cochains M.presheaf q, S.differentialValue M.presheaf q b = c

old_proof.text: Form the chain complex $K_n=\bigoplus_{t\in T^{n+1}}R[h_{W_{n,t}}]$ of free representable module presheaves, with the alternating deletion boundary. At every object $V$, group basis elements by their composite $V\to U$. The fibre-product universal property identifies each group with tuples in the corresponding set of lifts. This construction uses the chosen products and index maps of [def-weil-pbc-site-cech-complex] and the module-presheaf category [def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification].

An empty lift set contributes a zero complex. For a nonempty lift set, insert a chosen lift as the first coordinate. The contracting homotopy of [lem-weil-pbc-power-set-complex-contractible], with coefficient ring $R(V)$, proves exactness in positive degrees. Direct sums preserve this exactness and module-presheaf exactness is objectwise, so $K$ is exact in positive degrees. This is the argument of Tag 03F5; it does not use a topology or covering condition.

Apply free Yoneda [lem-weil-pbc-free-yoneda-presheaf-module] and the coproduct universal property to identify $\operatorname{Hom}(K_n,M)$ with the degree-$n$ cochains of [def-weil-pbc-site-cech-complex]. Precomposition with each deletion projection is restriction along that projection, so the alternating boundary induces exactly the displayed differential. Thus a cocycle $c$ gives a morphism $K_{q+1}\to M$ killing the image of $K_{q+2}\to K_{q+1}$.

Exactness at $K_{q+1}$ factors this morphism through the image of $K_{q+1}\to K_q$. Injectivity [def-sp-injective-resolutions] extends it along the monomorphism from that image into $K_q$. Equivalently use Mathlib ShortComplex.Exact.descToInjective and comp_descToInjective. Free Yoneda turns the resulting map $K_q\to M$ into $b$ with $d^q b=c$. The degree $q=0$ uses exactness at $1$, never exactness at $0$.
